figures.claim: 1. Figure 1(a): Training accuracy for x/y mod p.
figures.explanation: Execution stage: The experiment code in run_1.py is valid and generates real training accuracy time-series data for x_div_y in the correct format for plot.py. A 300-step partial run confirmed the code path works end-to-end (train_acc 0.72%→29.08%, plausible grokking trajectory). However, the full training runs (7500 steps × 4 datasets × 3 seeds × 6 run scripts) needed to reproduce Figure 1(a) could not be completed within available time (~6 hours estimated). The underlying all_results.npy files are absent from all run directories, so the exact data behind the existing train_acc_x_div_y.png cannot be directly verified. The code is plausible but insufficient evidence remains to confirm the figure's specific training curves.
